blocks.text: PIANO REMOVAL FAQ
Piano Removal in Whitby — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does piano removal cost in Whitby?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough — an upright or console costs less than a full grand piano, and stairs never add a surcharge.

items.q: Do you charge extra for stairs?
a: No. Narrow staircases and multi-floor moves are factored into one flat quote at the walkthrough.

items.q: What's involved in moving a grand or baby grand piano?
a: Legs, the lid and sometimes the pedal lyre come off to fit through doorways and stairwells, and the piano moves on proper piano boards.

items.q: Is this safe to do around kids and pets?
a: Yes — pathways stay clear and the crew paces the work around a normal family day, as standard practice.

items.q: My parent is downsizing and has a piano — how does that usually go?
a: Gently, at the family’s pace. Keepsakes and sheet music get set aside on request, and the piano clears in time for the move.

items.q: What happens to the piano once it's removed?
a: Donation partners are checked first for pianos that still play; only pianos beyond use go to recycling, where the metal frame and strings are separated for metal recyclers.

items.q: Can you remove a piano the same day I call?
a: Often, yes — trucks run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM.

items.q: Do you handle piano removal on rural properties toward Ashburn or Myrtle?
a: Yes, at the same flat pricing as anywhere else in Whitby.
